measurement_event_contract.qualified_session: privacy-safe first-party source, medium, campaign, immutable published asset_id, no PII; qualified only after bot/internal filtering
measurement_event_contract.cta_click: first-party free guide or approved merchant CTA intent, not a purchase
measurement_event_contract.affiliate_click: only after licensed issued link and explicit adjacent disclosure; distinct from qualified session
measurement_event_contract.confirmed_lead: Jetpack provider-confirmed opt-in, not front-end form submission
measurement_event_contract.verified_paid_order: provider/payhip settled order with unique order key, fees and refunds
measurement_event_contract.verified_affiliate_sale: independent partner reporting with settlement/refunds, not browser click
measurement_event_contract.realized_net: paid proceeds less refunds fees chargebacks and eligible costs; paid revenue/1000 only with qualified denominator

security_decisions: no customer email IP or fingerprint in attribution
all source links ordinary non-earning citations
no live WordPress or analytics changes
